# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus v0.6.7

The first release of PC Plus: Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 on PC with real keyboard and mouse play. It's based on [saulob's PC port](https://github.com/saulob/geometry-wars-retro-evolved-2-recompiled) v0.5.0, and everything from it is kept. This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## What's new

- **Mouse aim.** Hold the left mouse button and your shots go straight to the cursor, instantly, instead of sweeping round to it like a stick.
- **Right mouse button bombs**, and **Escape pauses** (and backs out of menus).
- **An animated neon crosshair** that replaces the cursor during a round: it flies in, spins, shifts colour and pinches while you fire, at bullet thickness so it never gets lost.
- **Keyboard prompts in every menu**: Enter Select, Esc Back, H How To Play, L Leaderboard. A controller button switches them back to Xbox buttons.
- **A keyboard and mouse controls screen** on every help screen, drawn in the game's own neon style.
- Keyboard X and Y now default to H and L.
- The launcher's updater follows PC Plus releases.

Turn on **Keyboard** on the launcher's Controls page to play with the keyboard and mouse.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v0.6.7-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Turn on **Keyboard** on the Controls page, and press **PLAY**.

Coming from saulob's port? Extract this over it, or copy your `user_data` folder across: settings, scores and achievements carry over.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## Known limits

- Switching the prompts back to Xbox buttons on a controller press has not been tested with a real controller yet.
- Windows only for now. The Linux build is unchanged from the original port and has not been rebuilt for PC Plus.
- The ReXGlue SDK this release was built with was compiled from source (v0.10.0), not taken from the prebuilt SDK download, which some antivirus engines flag.
